# ui::theme_colors

Namespace-scope declarations of `ui::theme_colors` from the themes headers.

A theme resource for every color of [ThemeColors](theme-colors.md), read from the theme each time it is used, so it follows light, dark and high contrast. `.with_alpha()` gives one at another opacity.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Border{.background = ui::theme_colors::Accent.with_alpha(0.7f)};
ui::Text{.text = "Saved", .foreground = ui::theme_colors::Success};
```
